def render_g_revenue_by_region(pdf, dataframes, x, y, w, h):
    # --- Obter dataframe principal (sales_pipeline) ---
    df = list(dataframes.values())[0]
    if df is None or df.empty:
        return

    # --- Agregar receita por região ---
    revenue_by_region = df.groupby('region', as_index=False)['revenue'].sum()

    # --- Mapear nomes de regiões para português ---
    region_map = {'North': 'Norte', 'South': 'Sul', 'West': 'Oeste'}
    revenue_by_region['region_pt'] = revenue_by_region['region'].map(region_map)

    # --- Obter metas (se disponível) ---
    targets_df = dataframes.get('regional_targets.xlsx')
    if targets_df is not None and not targets_df.empty:
        targets_df['region_pt'] = targets_df['region'].map(region_map)
        # Mesclar metas com receita
        data = revenue_by_region.merge(targets_df[['region_pt', 'quarterly_target']], on='region_pt', how='left')
    else:
        data = revenue_by_region.copy()
        data['quarterly_target'] = 0

    # --- Ordenar regiões consistentemente (Norte, Sul, Oeste) ---
    order = ['Norte', 'Sul', 'Oeste']
    data['region_pt'] = pd.Categorical(data['region_pt'], categories=order, ordered=True)
    data = data.sort_values('region_pt').reset_index(drop=True)

    # --- Calcular layout e dimensões do gráfico ---
    w_inch = w / 25.4
    h_inch = h / 25.4

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(w_inch, h_inch))
    fig.subplots_adjust(top=0.82, bottom=0.28, left=0.10, right=0.95)

    x_pos = np.arange(len(order))  # 0,1,2
    bar_width = 0.30
    opacity = 0.85

    # --- Barras de receita real ---
    bars_revenue = ax.bar(x_pos - bar_width/2, data['revenue'], bar_width,
                          label='Receita Real', color='#2E86AB', alpha=opacity, zorder=3)

    # --- Barras de meta (com hatch para distinguir) ---
    bars_target = ax.bar(x_pos + bar_width/2, data['quarterly_target'], bar_width,
                         label='Meta Trimestral', color='#F5A623', alpha=0.6,
                         hatch='///', edgecolor='#D4870A', linewidth=0.8, zorder=3)

    # --- Valor máximo para ajuste do eixo Y ---
    max_val = max(data['revenue'].max(), data['quarterly_target'].max())
    y_lim = max_val * 1.35  # headroom para labels
    ax.set_ylim(0, y_lim)

    # --- Rótulos nos topos das barras (valor formatado em milhar) ---
    for bar in bars_revenue:
        h_bar = bar.get_height()
        ax.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width() / 2., h_bar,
                f'R$ {h_bar:,.0f}'.replace(',', '.'),
                ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=6, fontweight='bold')

    for bar in bars_target:
        h_bar = bar.get_height()
        if h_bar > 0:
            ax.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width() / 2., h_bar,
                    f'R$ {h_bar:,.0f}'.replace(',', '.'),
                    ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=6, fontweight='bold')

    # --- Eixo X (regiões) ---
    ax.set_xticks(x_pos)
    ax.set_xticklabels(order, fontsize=CHART_TICK_FONTSIZE)

    # --- Eixo Y ---
    ax.yaxis.set_major_formatter(plt.FuncFormatter(lambda x, p: f'R$ {x:,.0f}'.replace(',', '.')))
    ax.tick_params(axis='y', labelsize=CHART_TICK_FONTSIZE)

    # --- Título ---
    ax.set_title('Receita por Região vs Meta Trimestral', fontsize=CHART_TITLE_FONTSIZE,
                 fontweight=CHART_TITLE_FONTWEIGHT, pad=CHART_TITLE_PAD)

    # --- Legenda (fora, abaixo) ---
    ax.legend(loc='upper center', bbox_to_anchor=(0.5, -0.18),
              ncol=2, frameon=False, fontsize=CHART_LEGEND_FONTSIZE)

    # --- Remover bordas desnecessárias ---
    ax.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
    ax.spines['right'].set_visible(False)

    # --- Salvar e inserir ---
    import tempfile, os
    with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(suffix=".png", delete=False) as tmp:
        plt.savefig(tmp.name, dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight', pad_inches=0.05)
        plt.close()
        pdf.image(tmp.name, x=x, y=y, w=w, h=h)
        os.unlink(tmp.name)

def render_g_revenue_by_product(pdf, dataframes, x, y, w, h):
    # Obtain primary dataset
    df = list(dataframes.values())[0]
    if df is None or df.empty:
        return

    # Aggregate revenue by product
    revenue_by_product = df.groupby('product', as_index=False)['revenue'].sum()
    revenue_by_product = revenue_by_product.sort_values('revenue', ascending=True)  # ascending for horizontal bars? No, vertical bars, sort descending for better visual
    # Actually we'll use descending for vertical bars
    revenue_by_product = revenue_by_product.sort_values('revenue', ascending=False)

    products = revenue_by_product['product'].tolist()
    revenues = revenue_by_product['revenue'].tolist()

    # Create figure with exact mm-to-inch conversion
    figsize_inches = (w / 25.4, h / 25.4)
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=figsize_inches)

    # Colors
    colors = sns.color_palette("viridis", n_colors=len(products))
    bars = ax.bar(products, revenues, color=colors, edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.5)

    # Title
    ax.set_title('Receita por Produto',
                 fontsize=CHART_TITLE_FONTSIZE,
                 fontweight=CHART_TITLE_FONTWEIGHT,
                 pad=CHART_TITLE_PAD)

    # Y-axis formatting (comma separator)
    ax.get_yaxis().set_major_formatter(plt.FuncFormatter(lambda x, p: f'R$ {int(x):,}'))

    # Tick sizes
    ax.tick_params(axis='x', labelsize=CHART_TICK_FONTSIZE)
    ax.tick_params(axis='y', labelsize=CHART_TICK_FONTSIZE)

    # Remove axis labels to avoid clutter in compact space
    ax.set_xlabel('')
    ax.set_ylabel('')

    # Adjust layout to fit title and x-tick labels
    fig.subplots_adjust(top=0.82, bottom=0.22, left=0.20, right=0.95)

    # Remove legend (single series)
    if ax.get_legend():
        ax.legend().remove()

    # Save to temporary PNG and insert into PDF
    with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(suffix=".png", delete=False) as tmp:
        plt.savefig(tmp.name, dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight', pad_inches=0.05)
        plt.close()
        pdf.image(tmp.name, x=x, y=y, w=w, h=h)
        os.unlink(tmp.name)

def render_g_discount_by_region(pdf, dataframes, x, y, w, h):

    df = list(dataframes.values())[0]
    if df is None or df.empty:
        return

    # Validate required columns
    if 'region' not in df.columns or 'discount_pct' not in df.columns:
        return

    # Compute average discount per region
    avg_discount = df.groupby('region', sort=False)['discount_pct'].mean().reset_index()
    # Sort descending for visual impact
    avg_discount = avg_discount.sort_values('discount_pct', ascending=False).reset_index(drop=True)

    regions = avg_discount['region'].tolist()
    values = avg_discount['discount_pct'].tolist()

    CHART_TITLE_FONTWEIGHT = 'bold'
    CHART_TITLE_PAD = 6

    CHART_TABLE_FONTSIZE = 6

    # Create figure with exact mm-to-inch conversion
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(w / 25.4, h / 25.4), constrained_layout=True)

    # Draw bars with a professional single hue
    bar_color = '#2c7fb8'
    bars = ax.bar(regions, values, color=bar_color, width=0.55, edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.5)

    # Title
    ax.set_title('Desconto Médio por Região', fontsize=CHART_TITLE_FONTSIZE,
                 fontweight=CHART_TITLE_FONTWEIGHT, pad=CHART_TITLE_PAD)

    # Y-axis label

    # X-axis: region names as tick labels, no xlabel (compact block)

    ax.tick_params(axis='y', labelsize=CHART_TICK_FONTSIZE)

    ax.set_axisbelow(True)

    # Remove spines for a clean look
    for spine in ['top', 'right']:
        ax.spines[spine].set_visible(False)

    # No data labels (compact block, h < 70mm)
    # No legend (single series)

    # Save to temp file and insert into PDF
    with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(suffix=".png", delete=False) as tmp:
        plt.savefig(tmp.name, dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight', pad_inches=0.05)
        plt.close()
        pdf.image(tmp.name, x=x, y=y, w=w, h=h)

import os
os.environ.setdefault('MPLCONFIGDIR', '/tmp/matplotlib')
import json
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import matplotlib as mpl
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
from fpdf import FPDF, XPos, YPos
import tempfile
import textwrap

CHART_TITLE_FONTSIZE = 9
CHART_TITLE_FONTWEIGHT = 'bold'
CHART_TITLE_PAD = 6
CHART_LABEL_FONTSIZE = 7
CHART_TICK_FONTSIZE = 6
CHART_LEGEND_FONTSIZE = 6
CHART_TABLE_FONTSIZE = 6
sns.set_theme(style='whitegrid')
mpl.rcParams.update({
    'axes.titlesize': CHART_TITLE_FONTSIZE,
    'axes.titleweight': CHART_TITLE_FONTWEIGHT,
    'axes.labelsize': CHART_LABEL_FONTSIZE,
    'xtick.labelsize': CHART_TICK_FONTSIZE,
    'ytick.labelsize': CHART_TICK_FONTSIZE,
    'legend.fontsize': CHART_LEGEND_FONTSIZE,
})

def _install_standard_chart_style():
    from matplotlib.axes import Axes
    original_set_title = Axes.set_title
    original_set_xlabel = Axes.set_xlabel
    original_set_ylabel = Axes.set_ylabel
    original_tick_params = Axes.tick_params
    original_legend = Axes.legend
    original_plt_legend = plt.legend
    def set_title(self, label, fontdict=None, loc=None, pad=None, *, y=None, **kwargs):
        fontdict = dict(fontdict or {})
        fontdict['fontsize'] = CHART_TITLE_FONTSIZE
        fontdict['fontweight'] = CHART_TITLE_FONTWEIGHT
        kwargs['fontsize'] = CHART_TITLE_FONTSIZE
        kwargs['fontweight'] = CHART_TITLE_FONTWEIGHT
        return original_set_title(self, label, fontdict=fontdict, loc=loc, pad=CHART_TITLE_PAD if pad is None else pad, y=y, **kwargs)
    def set_xlabel(self, xlabel, fontdict=None, labelpad=None, loc=None, **kwargs):
        fontdict = dict(fontdict or {})
        fontdict['fontsize'] = CHART_LABEL_FONTSIZE
        fontdict['fontweight'] = 'normal'
        kwargs['fontsize'] = CHART_LABEL_FONTSIZE
        kwargs['fontweight'] = 'normal'
        return original_set_xlabel(self, xlabel, fontdict=fontdict, labelpad=labelpad, loc=loc, **kwargs)
    def set_ylabel(self, ylabel, fontdict=None, labelpad=None, loc=None, **kwargs):
        fontdict = dict(fontdict or {})
        fontdict['fontsize'] = CHART_LABEL_FONTSIZE
        fontdict['fontweight'] = 'normal'
        kwargs['fontsize'] = CHART_LABEL_FONTSIZE
        kwargs['fontweight'] = 'normal'
        return original_set_ylabel(self, ylabel, fontdict=fontdict, labelpad=labelpad, loc=loc, **kwargs)
    def tick_params(self, axis='both', **kwargs):
        kwargs['labelsize'] = CHART_TICK_FONTSIZE
        return original_tick_params(self, axis=axis, **kwargs)
    def legend(self, *args, **kwargs):
        kwargs['fontsize'] = CHART_LEGEND_FONTSIZE
        return original_legend(self, *args, **kwargs)
    def plt_legend(*args, **kwargs):
        kwargs['fontsize'] = CHART_LEGEND_FONTSIZE
        return original_plt_legend(*args, **kwargs)
    Axes.set_title = set_title
    Axes.set_xlabel = set_xlabel
    Axes.set_ylabel = set_ylabel
    Axes.tick_params = tick_params
    Axes.legend = legend
    plt.legend = plt_legend

_install_standard_chart_style()

def _safe_pdf_text(value):
    replacements = {
        '\u2013': '-', '\u2014': '-', '\u2015': '-',
        '\u2018': "'", '\u2019': "'", '\u201c': '"', '\u201d': '"',
        '\u2022': '-', '\u00a0': ' ', '\u2026': '...'
    }
    text = str(value or '')
    for source, target in replacements.items():
        text = text.replace(source, target)
    return text.encode('latin-1', 'replace').decode('latin-1')

def _wrap_lines(text, max_chars):
    lines = []
    for paragraph in str(text).splitlines() or ['']:
        wrapped = textwrap.wrap(paragraph.strip(), width=max_chars) or ['']
        lines.extend(wrapped)
    return lines

def _sentence_chunks(text):
    normalized = ' '.join(str(text).split())
    chunks, current = [], []
    for token in normalized.split(' '):
        current.append(token)
        if token.rstrip().endswith(('.', '!', '?', ';')):
            chunks.append(' '.join(current))
            current = []
    if current:
        chunks.append(' '.join(current))
    return chunks or [normalized]

def _fit_text_to_box(text, w, h, font_size, line_height):
    max_chars = max(14, int(w * 0.55 * (10 / max(font_size, 1))))
    max_lines = max(1, int(h / max(line_height, 1)))
    if len(_wrap_lines(text, max_chars)) <= max_lines:
        return text
    selected = []
    for sentence in _sentence_chunks(text):
        candidate = ' '.join(selected + [sentence]).strip()
        if not candidate:
            continue
        if len(_wrap_lines(candidate, max_chars)) <= max_lines:
            selected.append(sentence)
        elif selected:
            break
        else:
            words = sentence.split()
            compact = []
            for word in words:
                candidate = ' '.join(compact + [word])
                if len(_wrap_lines(candidate, max_chars)) > max_lines:
                    break
                compact.append(word)
            selected.append(' '.join(compact))
            break
    fitted = ' '.join(selected).strip()
    return fitted

def _write_report_title(pdf, title, font_family):
    clean_title = ' '.join(_safe_pdf_text(title or 'Relatório Analítico').split())
    for size in range(16, 10, -1):
        max_chars = max(28, int(58 * (16 / size)))
        lines = textwrap.wrap(clean_title, width=max_chars) or [clean_title]
        if len(lines) <= 2:
            pdf.set_font(font_family, 'B', size)
            pdf.multi_cell(0, 8, '\n'.join(lines), new_x=XPos.LMARGIN, new_y=YPos.NEXT, align='C')
            return
    pdf.set_font(font_family, 'B', 11)
    pdf.multi_cell(0, 7, '\n'.join(textwrap.wrap(clean_title, width=84)), new_x=XPos.LMARGIN, new_y=YPos.NEXT, align='C')

def render_text_block(pdf, text, x, y, w, h, title=None):
    font_size = 10
    line_height = 5
    text = _safe_pdf_text(text)
    title = _safe_pdf_text(title) if title else None
    body_height = h
    pdf.set_xy(x, y)
    if title:
        pdf.set_font('helvetica', 'B', font_size)
        pdf.cell(w, 7, title, new_x=XPos.LMARGIN, new_y=YPos.NEXT)
        body_height = max(1, h - 8)
        pdf.set_xy(x, pdf.get_y())
    
    fitted_text = _fit_text_to_box(text, w, body_height, font_size, line_height)
    pdf.set_font('helvetica', '', font_size)
    pdf.multi_cell(w, line_height, fitted_text, align='J')

def render_g_discount_by_region(pdf, dataframes, x, y, w, h):
    # Obtain primary dataset
    df = list(dataframes.values())[0]
    if df is None or df.empty:
        return

    # Validate required columns
    if 'region' not in df.columns or 'discount_pct' not in df.columns:
        return

    # Compute average discount per region
    avg_discount = df.groupby('region', sort=False)['discount_pct'].mean().reset_index()
    # Sort descending for visual impact
    avg_discount = avg_discount.sort_values('discount_pct', ascending=False).reset_index(drop=True)

    regions = avg_discount['region'].tolist()
    values = avg_discount['discount_pct'].tolist()

    # Chart typography constants (shared by the renderer)
    CHART_TITLE_FONTSIZE = 9
    CHART_TITLE_FONTWEIGHT = 'bold'
    CHART_TITLE_PAD = 6
    CHART_LABEL_FONTSIZE = 7
    CHART_TICK_FONTSIZE = 6
    CHART_LEGEND_FONTSIZE = 6
    CHART_TABLE_FONTSIZE = 6

    # Create figure with exact mm-to-inch conversion
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(w / 25.4, h / 25.4), constrained_layout=True)

    # Draw bars with a professional single hue
    bar_color = '#2c7fb8'
    bars = ax.bar(regions, values, color=bar_color, width=0.55, edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.5)

    # Title
    ax.set_title('Desconto Médio por Região', fontsize=CHART_TITLE_FONTSIZE,
                 fontweight=CHART_TITLE_FONTWEIGHT, pad=CHART_TITLE_PAD)

    # Y-axis label
    ax.set_ylabel('Desconto (%)', fontsize=CHART_LABEL_FONTSIZE)

    # X-axis: region names as tick labels, no xlabel (compact block)
    ax.set_xlabel('')
    ax.tick_params(axis='x', labelsize=CHART_TICK_FONTSIZE)
    ax.tick_params(axis='y', labelsize=CHART_TICK_FONTSIZE)

    # Y-axis range: give headroom so bars don't touch top
    max_val = max(values)
    ax.set_ylim(0, max_val * 1.35)

    # Add a subtle horizontal grid for readability
    ax.yaxis.grid(True, linestyle='--', alpha=0.3)
    ax.set_axisbelow(True)

    # Remove spines for a clean look
    for spine in ['top', 'right']:
        ax.spines[spine].set_visible(False)

    # No data labels (compact block, h < 70mm)
    # No legend (single series)

    # Save to temp file and insert into PDF
    with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(suffix=".png", delete=False) as tmp:
        plt.savefig(tmp.name, dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight', pad_inches=0.05)
        plt.close()
        pdf.image(tmp.name, x=x, y=y, w=w, h=h)
        os.unlink(tmp.name)
